name: ContactPose: A Dataset of Grasps with Object Contact and Hand Pose
description: ContactPose is a multimodal hand-object interaction dataset capturing dense contact surface maps and 3D hand poses for human grasps on everyday household objects. Jointly created by Meta AI and Georgia Tech, ContactPose encompasses 2,306 unique grasps across 50 human participants interacting with 25 3D-printed household objects (including tools, utensils, mugs, and personal items). Contact patterns were captured using high-resolution thermal imaging cameras immediately following physical grasps to record residual heat signatures, synchronized with multi-view RGB-D video and OptiTrack 3D hand kinematics fitted to the MANO model.

provenance.collection_method: Thermal camera imaging recording thermal dissipation on 3D printed objects immediately after hand release, registered with OptiTrack 3D hand tracking and multi-view RGB-D cameras.
provenance.curation_notes: Captures two distinct grasp intents per object: functional use grasps (e.g., using a knife) and handover grasps (e.g., passing a knife).
